waypoints.name: Leavitt Meadows Trailhead
waypoints.directions: From US-395 at Sonora Junction, about 17 miles north of Bridgeport, turn west on CA-108 and drive about 7 miles to Leavitt Meadows Campground. Overnight hiker parking is at the lot just as you enter the campground. A Hoover Wilderness permit is required for overnight trips.

waypoints.name: Tower Peak
waypoints.directions: Walk through the campground, cross the West Walker River on the footbridge and follow the West Walker River Trail south past Lower and Upper Piute Meadows, turning at the signed junction in Upper Piute Meadows to climb to Tower Lake. Go up to Tower Pass, cross the basin beyond, climb slabs to the northwest ridge, then leave it onto the west side and traverse into the Northwest Chute, scrambling class 3 to the summit.
